title: Steadfastness Under Persecution
paragraphs: During the earliest and most dangerous years of his mission, the Prophet ﷺ faced consistent threats, social boycotts, and physical harm from powerful figures determined to suppress his growing message.

Despite repeated opportunities to abandon his mission in exchange for wealth, status, or safety, he consistently declined, maintaining that his responsibility to deliver the message outweighed any personal comfort or security available to him.

One particularly striking account describes him being offered considerable worldly incentives to stop, which he refused entirely, stating that even significant material rewards could not outweigh the importance of his responsibility.

This period of sustained pressure without corresponding compromise is often studied today as an example of maintaining core convictions despite genuinely severe and prolonged external pressure to abandon them.
